title: Solo safety: at 0 HP the PC collapses — a setback, never a death sentence

llm_context.canon: Aria is a SOLO adventurer at 5 of 30 hit points. A ghoul is attacking her. Table rule: when a solo PC drops to 0 hit points, the scene ends in a setback — capture, rescue, waking robbed or dragged clear — never character death.

canon_facts.fact: Aria is a solo PC; dropping to 0 HP is a setback, not death.

script.speaker: Aria
script.message: I stand my ground and swing at the ghoul.

actions.text: Your blade opens its arm, but the ghoul doesn't stop. It bowls you off your feet and the world tilts sideways into black.
You wake later by the cold press of stone. The ghoul is gone; your pack is lighter by a ration and a pouch of coins, but you're breathing. Barely. The crypt has let you off with a warning.
